title: Customer Audit Sandbox & Evidence Simulator
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a self-serve Audit Sandbox that lets customers simulate common audit requests, validate their data residency and retention settings, and generate an exportable audit package (evidence bundle) for internal reviewers or third-party auditors. The sandbox will surface how Redwood assembles evidence (logs, residency snapshots, retention policies, encryption metadata, DPA attachments) and provide guided remediation steps for misconfigurations.

Scope: MVP covers: (1) a web UI in Console that walks through three audit scenarios (SOC-like access review, DPA data residency check, retention policy verification), (2) a synthetic evidence generator that creates realistic-but-scrubbed artifacts (log excerpts, storage residency maps, retention snapshots), (3) an export builder that packages evidence into a downloadable ZIP and produces a short narrative report, and (4) RBAC preview toggles to show what a customer-admin vs auditor sees.

Non-goals: This MVP will not run full legal review workflows, will not send evidence to third-party auditors automatically, and will not alter production retention or residency settings (only read-only simulation).

Design decisions / trade-offs: We will generate synthetic artifacts derived from customer metadata and anonymized sample records instead of copying live production records to avoid risk. The simulator will surface definitive residency and retention status using read-only snapshots from the control plane; however, change actions will be surfaced as one-click links to the relevant settings page rather than applied directly.

Integration points: 1) Evidence export service (ENG-5022) to assemble bundles, 2) Residency snapshot API (ENG-5199) for region mapping, 3) Retention policy registry (ENG-5240) for verification, 4) Console feature flagging for staged rollout.

Artifacts and links: Confluence PRD: https://redwood.atl/confluence/display/CC/Audit+Sandbox+PRD (internal) | Design spec (Figma): https://figma.com/file/xyz123/audit-sandbox | Spike notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcSandboxSpike | Spike PR (backend stub): https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8142

Success metrics (MVP): 1) 10 pilot customers use the sandbox within the first month, 2) >80% of sandbox sessions view the suggested remediation steps, 3) evidence bundle generation succeeds with <5% errors, 4) NPS signal from pilot customers >= +40 for audit tooling usefulness.
acceptance_criteria: Console has a new Audit Sandbox entry point with three guided scenarios and contextual help
Simulator generates synthetic, scrubbed evidence artifacts (logs, residency map, retention snapshot) within 30s for pilot accounts
Export builder packages artifacts and a 1-page narrative report into a downloadable ZIP (PDF + JSON manifest)
RBAC preview toggles correctly change visible fields between admin and auditor personas
End-to-end tests for evidence bundle assembly are present (integration with ENG-5022) and pass in CI
